cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the digital land register covers the whole country.
cells.note: e-Foncier Benin holds 643,993 parcels across 12 communes, three of them fully covered, and ANDF e-services take land title requests online. National coverage is the aim of PPMEC II and TERRA BENIN, not yet a fact, so not 4.
